name: working-agreement
description: Optional house rules for how the agent works with you: keep it simple, look facts up instead of asking, one decision per question that yes accepts, and explanations that lead with what a thing means for you and a concrete case before the mechanism and its name. One hook adds them at session start; a second sends each question the agent is about to ask you to a Sonnet subagent, which answers it from the repository or your earlier words, or settles it as a reversible choice, so only the questions that need you reach you.
